main_text.head: De Reciprocatione. CAP. X.
main_text.p: VID eft Reciprocatio? Affectio locorü eiufmodi, vt fi cöfentanei fint, vno conceffó vel negato, alterü concedatur, vel negetur: fi diffentanei, contrà vno pofito, vel fublato, alterum ponatur, vel tollatur. Nam in eos demum locos reciprocatio conuenit, quorum paria in vtranque partem momenta funt. quorum naturæ ordine neutrü altero prius aut pofterius eft, fed vtrunque fimul. veluti, Proprium & fpecies: canfla[?] & effectus. At genus cum fpecie non reciprocatur: nec totum cum parte. quoniam illa priora funt naturæ ordine, vt fuo loco diximus. Huius autem difcipline maximus

page.notes: The woodcut initial is a decorated V; read as "VID". The word "canfla" is uncertain, possibly "causa" printed with a long-s-like letter; marked [?]. The grave accents in "Pòft" and "conceffó" are as printed. The dot at the bottom centre is a speck, not text.
